title: Stock Price Observer
instructions: Implement the Observer pattern across `stock/observer.py`, `stock/publisher.py` and `stock/manager.py`. Declare the `Observer` interface with `send_notification(stock_name, current_price)` and update the three channel services. Make `Publisher` keep an `observers` list and notify in order, and make `StockTradingManager` notify only when the new price is strictly above its threshold. `ObserverRegistry` is provided.

evidence.label: Observer is an ABC and each channel prints its own notification
Publisher keeps a per-instance observers list
Every observer is notified in subscription order
An unsubscribed observer is not notified
Observers can subscribe at runtime and see later updates only
Manager is a Publisher with the right initial state
Notifies only when price is strictly above the threshold
Price is updated even when nobody is notified
Real channels work through the manager in order
